args.title: Persist chosen export format across sessions
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's chosen export format (e.g. in localStorage) when the select's onChange fires, and initialize the `format` state from that stored value instead of always defaulting to the `defaultFormat`/"csv" prop.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The component initializes its `format` state directly from the `defaultFormat`/"csv" prop with no persistence layer, so the chosen export format is lost on each page load, matching the reporter's request to remember it.
